answer: New identities trade only under expiring vouchers issued by unrelated clients who lock funds in a shared vault. A voucher lasts one epoch and renews only after the client confirms delivered work. At the kernel of the rule is outside demand: fakes trading among themselves receive no vouchers and stay inactive. One honest agent earns renewal from its real clients, solid as timber. A sybil farmer must recruit and pay genuine clients for every fake, epoch after epoch, so fabrication costs recurring outside money.
